# Challenge 1: find the hidden class

The app has a class that is not mentioned anywhere in its UI. Find it, and
name all of its methods.

**Hints**:

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

`fridaCj re.frida` lists everything in the app's package.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

The interesting classes live under `secret`, `game` and `license`.
</details>

Work through [Discovering classes](../android_journey/discovering_classes.qmd)
if you need the commands.
